blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists may see gasoline prices drop by as much as P4.20 a liter next week, while diesel prices could rise, an industry source said. Gasoline prices will like drop by P4 to P4.20 a liter for the week of Oct. 19, while diesel prices may rise by P0.20 to P0.40 a liter.
